similarities.claim: Provides an SDK for building agents that interact with code, tools, and actions.
Documents evaluation harness support for integrating benchmarks.
Composes agents and tools via SDK package boundaries and delegation surfaces.

differences.claim: Targets software-agent execution platforms more than project-local scaffold governance.

lessons_for_afol.lesson: Keep execution isolation and permission boundaries explicit when agents can run commands or edit files.
Treat benchmark fixtures as first-class regression assets rather than ad hoc demos.
Keep agent composition and delegation boundaries explicit in the SDK rather than implicit in prompts.

do_not_copy.reason: Do not make the governance layer depend on a heavy remote agent runtime.
